archetypes.name: dyn-gate-b-load
archetypes.rationale: Review the deferred Gate B explicit-mode load contract and moved prompt text.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the /design Gate B reference split. Verify that default auto-apply no longer needs to load the explicit prompt file, while --per-round-approval still loads it after zero-findings and post-apply resume guards. Check that the moved prompt text keeps option labels, Python-owned count bindings, and one-by-one iteration rules intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
